effort_basis: Measured agent wall-clock windows including local review, tool waits and writing. Not human analyst labor; not billed model compute. Original interruption is excluded.

turkey_india_israel.instrumentation_limit: First recovery local reads precede this timer; previous attempt has start but no verified session-end. Do not equate interruption interval to analyst effort.

previous_attempt_start.note: start of group instrumented capture; initial local inspection and 2 web calls precede capture

turkey_india_israel.prior_tool_request_count_not_claimed: Bundle count is not a request count; source openings/searches are retained in4webJSONcaptures.
turkey_india_israel.declined_geocode_command: Not executed; zero result assumed from declinedqueue3.

china_uk_algeria.measurement_scope: Wall-clock reviewer activity window including local reading/tool waits; not human analyst labor. Original interrupted window not added to resume elapsed.
china_uk_algeria.browser_backend_request_count: Not exposed; five preserved tool result captures are not claimed as five HTTP requests.
china_uk_algeria.monetary_cost: No paid API used; provider/network/compute monetary cost not measured.

china_uk_algeria.note: Waiting for reviewer JSON is not counted as human analyst labor.

root_recovery_start.note: Recovery/new work only; exclude historical usage-limit interruption from analyst effort.

limits: Initial recovery reads precede root timer.
Original reviewer active duration cannot be reconstructed reliably; no invented analyst hours.
Parallel reviewer windows must not be treated as serial wall time.
Provider backend HTTP counts and model compute costs are not exposed.

calibration: Keep metadata binding effort separate from institution site recovery. Ten U holds limit extrapolation to remediation throughput; unresolved does not mean unreviewed.
